title: Velvet
Hour
hero.sub: A live-band soul and funk revue built to get the whole room dancing. Two nights at The Anthem, a twelve-piece band, and a show where the crowd is part of the act.

nights.heading: Pick your night

points.text: Slow jams and ballads all night
The Heart Cam during the slow jam
A slow dance under the mirror ball to close
Gold confetti cannons for the finale

nights.note: Two nights, two setlists. No song is played twice.

about.heading: Two nights, two shows, and the crowd is part of both
paragraphs: Rio Delacroix does not let up. Friday is Slow Burn: candlelight, quiet-storm ballads, June Halloway's ballad duet, the Heart Cam during the slow jam, and one last slow dance under the mirror ball.

Saturday is Full Funk: the horn section up front, a surprise guest, a Dance Cam dance-off, gold confetti cannons over the whole room and an afterparty until 2 AM. Two setlists, and no song is played twice. Come to one night or both; either way, you will not be watching from the outside.

speakers.heading: Lineup
speakers.intro: One headliner, one opener who comes back for a duet, a band built for stamina, and a different DJ each night.

items.name: Rio Delacroix
items.bio: Singer, dancer and bandleader-in-chief. Rio runs a two-hour revue without a single sit-down moment, and the encore is never the same twice.
items.alt: Rio Delacroix singing into a microphone on a smoky stage
items.style: Soul and funk showman / New Orleans, LA
items.about: Rio Delacroix learned to work a room at a family supper club and never learned to stand still. Two hours, no sit-down moment, a horn hit for every spin. Every night ends with an encore that has never been played the same way twice.

items.name: June Halloway
items.role: Opener, and a different duet each night
items.alt: June Halloway singing into a microphone
items.about: June Halloway grew up singing in DC church choirs and writes ballads that sound like late-night radio. June opens both nights, then comes back for a duet: a slow one on Friday, a fast one on Saturday.

items.name: Theo Okafor
items.role: Band leader and keys, The Chrome Section
items.alt: Theo Okafor playing keys and singing on stage
items.style: Keys and musical director / Atlanta, GA
items.about: Theo Okafor leads The Chrome Section from behind a stack of keyboards. Theo counts in every scene, calls the breaks and decides when the band plays one more.

items.name: The Brass Satellites
items.role: Horn section: two trumpets, tenor sax, trombone
items.alt: The Brass Satellites' sax player blowing a solo on stage
items.about: The Brass Satellites are two trumpets, a tenor sax and a trombone that play like twice as many. On Saturday they open the show from the lip of the stage.

items.name: DJ Polly Ester
items.role: DJ, Fri - Slow Burn and the Friday afterparty
items.alt: DJ Polly Ester at the decks with headphones around the neck
items.style: Quiet-storm and disco DJ / Baltimore, MD
items.about: DJ Polly Ester digs for late-night soul and smooth grooves. Polly sets the mood before Friday's Slow Burn and keeps the lounge glowing at the afterparty.

items.name: DJ Lola Lava
items.role: DJ, Sat - Full Funk and the Saturday afterparty
items.alt: DJ Lola Lava mixing with headphones on
items.style: Boogie and funk DJ / Chicago, IL
items.about: DJ Lola Lava plays boogie, roller-rink funk and drum breaks that pull people onto the floor. Lola warms up Saturday, scores the Dance Cam dance-off and closes the weekend at 2 AM.

items.name: Bobbie Dazzle
items.role: Host, Heart Cam and Dance Cam ringleader
items.alt: Bobbie Dazzle in a black suit and sunglasses, adjusting a tie
items.style: Host and crowd-cam ringleader / Washington, DC
items.about: Bobbie Dazzle runs the room between scenes: the lottery draw, the crowd cam warm-up, Friday's Heart Cam and Saturday's dance-off. If you are on the big screen, Bobbie probably put you there.

items.name: Surprise guest
items.role: Sat - Full Funk only. Name not announced.
items.alt: A plum silhouette with a gold question mark
items.about: Saturday only. You'll know when the lights go out.

schedule.heading: Run of show
schedule.note: Set times are a guide. When the room asks for one more, the band plays one more.

sessions.title: Soundcheck and band Q&A
sessions.detail: The band runs the ballads at half volume, then takes your questions.

sessions.title: Early entry
sessions.detail: In before the doors open. Front Rail heads straight to the rail.

sessions.title: Doors
sessions.detail: Bars and merch open. Candles on every lounge table.

sessions.title: Front rail lottery draw
sessions.detail: Every Dance Floor ticket and Both nights pass scanned by 6:55 PM is in. Winners get a text and a rail wristband.

sessions.title: DJ set: quiet storm
sessions.detail: Late-night soul and smooth grooves to set the mood.

sessions.title: Opener: June Halloway
sessions.detail: Forty minutes of new soul, mostly ballads.

sessions.title: Scene: Candlelight
sessions.detail: One spotlight, one piano, and "Velvet Ultimatum" at half speed.

sessions.title: Scene: The Quiet Storm
sessions.detail: Rhodes, strings and "Rain on the Radio Dial".

sessions.title: Duet: June Halloway's ballad
sessions.detail: June returns for "Two Coats, One Umbrella".

sessions.title: Scene: The Slow Jam
sessions.detail: Lights down, phones up, "Slow Dance at the Roller Rink".

sessions.title: Heart Cam
sessions.detail: During the slow jam the Heart Cam finds couples, friends and strangers and puts them on the big screen.

sessions.title: Scene: Last Call Ballads
sessions.detail: The horns play soft for "Porch Light On".

sessions.title: Finale: Slow dance under the mirror ball
sessions.detail: House lights off, mirror ball on, one last slow dance for the whole room.

sessions.title: Encore
sessions.detail: One more slow one. Different every night.

sessions.title: Afterparty: The Quiet Storm Lounge
sessions.detail: Upstairs lounge, low lights, one more DJ set.

sessions.title: Soundcheck and band Q&A
sessions.detail: Watch the horns rehearse the dance-off breaks, then ask them anything.

sessions.title: Early entry
sessions.detail: In before the doors open. Front Rail heads straight to the rail.

sessions.title: Doors
sessions.detail: Bars and merch open.

sessions.title: Front rail lottery draw
sessions.detail: A fresh draw. Friday's result does not carry over, so Both nights pass holders get a second chance.

sessions.title: Crowd cam warm-up
sessions.detail: The Dance Cam goes live and scouts tonight's dance-off contenders.

sessions.title: DJ set: boogie and breaks
sessions.detail: Boogie, roller-rink funk and drum breaks to warm up the floor.

sessions.title: Opener: June Halloway
sessions.detail: Forty minutes of new soul, the uptempo set.

sessions.title: Scene: Horns Up Front
sessions.detail: The Brass Satellites open from the lip of the stage with "Chrome Heart Shuffle".

sessions.title: Scene: The Funk Breakdown
sessions.detail: Bass and horns trade breaks on "Platform Shoes Required".

sessions.title: Duet: June Halloway, uptempo
sessions.detail: June returns for a fast one, "Roller Rink Royalty".

sessions.title: Dance Cam dance-off
sessions.detail: Bobbie Dazzle picks dancers from the floor and the balcony. The room votes by noise.

sessions.title: Surprise guest
sessions.detail: Saturday only. One name we are not printing.

sessions.title: Scene: The Mirror Ball
sessions.detail: The light-up floor takes over and the whole room dances.

sessions.title: Finale: Gold confetti cannons
sessions.detail: Sixteen cannons of gold confetti over the whole room, balcony included.

sessions.title: Encore
sessions.detail: Different every night.

sessions.title: Afterparty until 2 AM
sessions.detail: Upstairs lounge, last dance of the weekend.

tickets.heading: Tickets
tickets.intro: Every ticket is for one night: pick Slow Burn or Full Funk. Want both? The Both nights pass covers Dance Floor on Friday and Saturday for less than two singles. Pick a column to choose a ticket. Hover or tap a row to see exactly what it covers.

rows.label: Nights
rows.detail: Single tickets are for Friday (Slow Burn) or Saturday (Full Funk); you choose at checkout. The Both nights pass gets you in on both.

rows.label: Saving on two nights
rows.detail: Two Dance Floor singles cost $170. The Both nights pass is $150, so you save $20.

rows.label: Reserved seat
rows.detail: A numbered balcony seat. Soundcheck VIP gets a balcony box seat on top of floor access.

rows.label: Guaranteed front rail
rows.detail: A spot at the rail, held until the first scene starts.

rows.label: Merch
rows.detail: Picked up at the merch desk. Front Rail and Both nights get the tour tee. Soundcheck VIP gets the tee and a numbered screen-printed poster.

tickets.footnote: Prices include fees. Tickets can be transferred until 48 hours before the show.

venue.heading: Getting there
venue.intro: The Anthem sits on The Wharf in Southwest DC. Metro is the easiest way in; plan your ride home before the encore.

items.title: Address
items.body: 901 Wharf St SW, Washington, DC 20024, at The Wharf.

items.title: Metro
items.body: Waterfront station on the Green Line, about a 10-minute walk. Check the last train time before you stay for the afterparty.

items.title: Rideshare
items.body: Use the marked drop-off and pickup zone on Maine Ave SW. After the show, walk to the zone before you book; the streets right outside the doors back up fast.

items.title: Bag policy
items.body: A small purse or bag is fine. Backpacks and bags larger than a small purse are searched and go to coat check. No coolers, and no outside food or drinks.

items.title: ID
items.body: Bring a valid government-issued photo ID to buy or drink alcohol. Shows are all ages unless posted. Front Rail and Soundcheck VIP check-in matches your ID to the name on the ticket.

items.title: Accessibility
items.body: Accessible seating is available at every show. Request accommodations in advance through the venue.

dancecam.intro: On the night, the Dance Cam roams the floor and the balcony and puts you on the big screen. Try the broadcast here first: pick an effect, step on the floor, take a snapshot.

items.q: Is it the same show both nights?
items.a: No. Friday is Slow Burn: ballads, a ballad duet with June Halloway, the Heart Cam and a slow dance under the mirror ball to close. Saturday is Full Funk: horns up front, a surprise guest, a Dance Cam dance-off, gold confetti cannons and an afterparty until 2 AM. Two setlists, and no song is played twice.

items.q: Do I need a ticket for each night?
items.a: Yes, every single ticket is for one night. If you want both, the Both nights pass is Dance Floor on Friday and Saturday for $150, which is $20 less than two singles.

items.q: How does the front rail lottery work?
items.a: Every Dance Floor ticket gets one draw for its night, and the Both nights pass gets one draw each night. Scan in by 6:55 PM and you are entered automatically. The draw happens at 7:00 PM; winners get a text and a rail wristband and head to the front before the opener. Friday's draw does not carry over, so Saturday is a fresh chance.

items.q: Does the Dance Cam record anything?
items.a: No. At the show, the Dance Cam and Friday's Heart Cam are live feeds to the big screen and nothing else: nothing is recorded, saved or streamed. If you would rather not be on screen, cross your arms in an X and the operator moves on. The Dance Cam tryout on this site runs entirely in your browser. Your camera picture never leaves your device, and a snapshot is only kept if you press Save, which saves it to your own device.
Doors are at 6:30 PM both nights and the crowd cam warm-up starts at 7:15 PM. Rio Delacroix is on stage around 9:30 PM. Front Rail and Soundcheck VIP can come in from 6:00 PM.

items.q: Will I get confetti in the balcony?
items.a: On Saturday, yes. The gold confetti cannons are aimed at the whole room, balcony included. Friday ends with a slow dance under the mirror ball instead.
No. Velvet for Friday, sequins and platforms for Saturday, if you want a theme. Both catch the Dance Cam's eye.

items.q: Can I bring a bag or a camera?
items.a: A small purse or bag is fine. Backpacks and bags larger than a small purse are searched and go to coat check. No coolers, and no outside food or drinks. Phones are fine. Professional cameras with detachable lenses are not. See Getting there for the rest.
Velvet Hour is all ages. Under 16s need to be with an adult. You need a valid government-issued photo ID to buy or drink alcohol.
